T h is appeal coming on for order this day, t h e cou   following:

ORDER This appeal has been filed by the appellant Insurance Company under Section 173 (1) of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 against the award dated 25.10.2016 passed in MACC.No.1820 of 2013 by 7th Additional M.A.C.T., Bhopal, District- Bhopal, seeking reduction of compensation amount.

2. Learned counsel for the appellant submits that Tribunal has wrongly applied multiplier of 7,
whereas, in view of age of deceased, multiplier of 5 should have been applied.
On above ground, it is urged that compensation awarded by the Tribunal be suitably reduced.
3. Learned counsel for respondents submits that compensation awarded by the Tribunal is just and proper.
No reduction is required in the compensation awarded by the Tribunal.
Learned counsel for the claimants submits that rate of interest awarded by the Tribunal be enhanced to 9% from 6%.
4. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.
5. So far as multiplier is concerned, on the date of accident, deceased was aged more than 65 years.

Hence, in view of law laid down in Sarla Verma & others vs. Delhi Transport Corporation & another reported in (2009) 6 SCC 121, multiplier of 5 is applicable and not 7.
6.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: So far as rate of interest is concerned, Tribunal has awarded interest @ 6% per annum.
No cross objection has been filed on behalf of the respondents/claimants.
Therefore, rate of interest can not be enhanced from 6% to 9%.
7. In view of above/ i.e., as multiplier of 5 is applicable, compensation awarded by the Tribunal is reduced by Rs.2,95,032/-.
8. Amount awarded by the Tribunal is reduced by Rs.2,95,032/-.
Other findings of the Tribunal shall remain intact.
